rooms.name: A Narrow Pass Through the Mountains
rooms.desc:
You have entered a narrow pass. On both sides of you, the granite walls
climb steeply up and out of sight. The ground has been covered with sand in
the manner of a semi-primitive road. You feel almost trapped in the small
space that you have. The pass continues to the north.

rooms.name: A Narrow Pass Through the Mountains
rooms.desc:
You are in a narrow pass. On both sides of you, the granite walls climb
steeply up and out of sight. The ground has been covered with sand in the 
manner of a semi-primitive road. You feel almost trapped in the small space
that you have. The pass continues to the north, while the entrance to the
pass lies just to the south.

rooms.name: A Narrow Pass Through the Mountains
rooms.desc:
You are in a narrow pass. On both sides of you, the granite walls climb
steeply up and out of sight. The ground has been covered with sand in the
manner of a semi-primitive road. You feel almost trapped in the small space
that you have.
   To the north, the pass widens out into a valley with a small village at
the entrance to the pass.  The pass continues to the south.

rooms.name: At the Southern Entrance to a Small Village
rooms.desc:
You stand at the entrance to a small village. Looking inside, you can see
that the village and villagers are semi-primitive, though the village's
walls are made of granite and look as if they could withstand a decent
sized army.
   The gate to the north is generally left open, as if travelers are very
welcome here. You notice that the temperature has dropped dramatically
since leaving the pass.
   There is a small sign here.

rooms.name: Inside the Village
rooms.desc:
You are standing inside a small fishing village. You watch as busy people
go about their daily lives. All around are small uninteresting looking huts.
You hear what sounds like some sort of auction to your east. It's pretty cold 
in here, but nothing you can't handle.

rooms.name: The Marketplace
rooms.desc:
You have entered the marketplace. All sorts of people are here selling fish,
fish, and more fish. You try to find vendors selling something else, but with  
all the fish vendors, the others seem to get lost in the crowd. You hear what
sounds like an auction to the north and east. It's much warmer in here with 
all the people crowded together.

rooms.name: The Marketplace
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the marketplace amongst all sorts of merchants.
Although there are still mostly fish vendors, you find that the other
vendors and merchants have firm holds on some territory here in the
back.
   You hear what sounds like an auction to the north and west.

rooms.name: Inside the Village
rooms.desc:
You are standing inside a small fishing village. You watch as busy people 
go about their daily lives. All around are small uninteresting looking huts.
To the north and east is a large, solid looking wall of granite. To the south

nothing you can't handle.

rooms.name: Inside the Chieftain's Hut
rooms.desc:
You have entered the hut of the village's Chief Shartu. Looking at
the maps around the room, you can see that a group of giant-like 
people live to the northeast and are, to all appearances, preparing
for war.
   There is a sign on the wall.

rooms.name: Inside the Village
rooms.desc:
You are standing inside a small fishing village. You watch as busy people

To the north is a large, solid looking wall of granite. It's pretty cold in
here, but nothing you can't handle.

rooms.name: Inside the Village
rooms.desc:
You are standing inside a small fishing village. You watch as busy people
go about their daily lives. All around are small uninteresting looking huts. 
   To the north and west is a large, solid-looking wall of granite.  To the
south, a large hut bears strange, arcane symbols on its side, making you
wonder who lives inside. It's pretty cold in here, but nothing you can't
handle.

rooms.name: Inside the Shaman's Hut
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the hut of the village shaman. All sorts of strange
items lie strewn about the place, possibly spell components, possibly junk.A
fire pit keeps this room nice and warm.

rooms.name: Inside a Cozy Inn
rooms.desc:
You have entered a cozy little building which seems to be the closest 
thing this village has to an inn. There are a few pallets on the ground, 
and this DOES at least seem like a good place to rest your weary bones. There 
is a bartender here, selling food and beverages. A roaring fireplace keeps 
the temperature at a point where you almost feel like falling asleep. This
building seems a bit more modern compared to the rest of the huts.

rooms.name: At the Northern Entrance to a Small Village
rooms.desc:
You stand at the entrance to a small fishing village. The large granite
wall and the locked gates look very impressive, and not very welcoming.
   To the north, east, and west, the valley you are in is mostly frozen
tundra, but you can just make out a lake far to the north.  To the south,
you see the village gates. It's very cold out here.

rooms.name: A Frozen Valley
rooms.desc:
You are wandering around in a valley hidden within the Bhyroga mountains.
The valley is very hilly, and you have a hard time walking here. In all 
directions, you can see the mountains looming above you. To the south, you 
can see the small fishing village known only as Bhyroga. You're freezing your 
ass off, better have some damn thick blankets for the night.

rooms.name: A Frozen Valley
rooms.desc:

The valley is very hilly, and you have a hard time walking here.
   In all directions, you can see the mountains looming above you.  To the
southeast, you can see the small fishing village known only as Bhyroga.
   You're freezing your ass off in this bitter cold.  Better have some
damn thick blankets for the night.

rooms.desc:

covered in ice.  It appears safe to walk on, so thick and white is the
ice.
   You feel like you're freezing.  Be careful of frostbite.

covered with ice.  It looks safe to walk on.
   You feel like you're freezing.  Be careful of frostbite.

   A cave opens in a mountain wall to the east, offering you shelter from

  You're freezing your ass off.  Better have some damn thick blankets for
the night.

rooms.name: Lake Darthis
rooms.desc:
You're traveling on a frozen lake. It's just one big sheet of ice. You
feel EXTREMELY cold out here!!!

rooms.name: Lake Darthis
rooms.desc:

feel EXTREMELY cold out here!!!
   Holes appear in the ice to the north and west.

   Cracks in the ice form large holes to the south and west.

rooms.name: A Hole in the Ice
rooms.desc:
The is a very large hole in the ice here. You can see an amazing number
of fish in the water. This must be where the villagers of Bhyroga get all
their fish. You wonder how they can stand the cold. 
   The ice breaks away into floes that bob across the surface of the water
to the west. Even from here, you can feel the frigid updrafts that would
freeze you should you take to the air or water over its surface.

rooms.name: In Freezing Water
rooms.desc:
You are down in freezing water! How can you bear the cold?!? Are you 
insane? There is a passage down under the ice to the north, full of more 
freezing water, but you are unsure if you should stay down here long.

rooms.name: In Freezing Water
rooms.desc:
You will surely die if you stay here long.  Already you have lost feeling
in your extremities and the cold water has sucked the life out of your lungs.
   Better keep moving.

rooms.name: In Freezing Water
rooms.desc:
You are down in freezing water! How can you bear the cold?!? Are you 
insane? There is a passage down under the ice to the north and south, full of 
more freezing water, but you are unsure if you should stay down here long.

rooms.name: In Freezing Water
rooms.desc:
You are down in freezing water! How can you bear the cold?!? Are you 
insane? There is a passage down under the ice to the south, full of more 
freezing water, but you will surely die if you stay down here much longer. 
Above you there is a dark hole in the ice.

rooms.name: The Hidden Cave
rooms.desc:
You manage to pull yourself from the frozen water into this dry cave.
It's a large cave, and appears to have been abandoned for decades, but you
hear a loud snoring sound coming from the room to the north. Wonder what it
could be? Below you, there is a hole leading to some freezing water.

rooms.name: The Hidden Cave
rooms.desc:
You have entered a large cave with a very large dragon. Your entry has
awakened the beast, and he doesnt look too pleased about it. The temperature
is so cold in here that you're afraid to flex your fingers.

rooms.name: A Treasure Room
rooms.desc:
You are in the ice dragon's treasure room!! Better take what you can get
before he finds you.

rooms.name: A Small Cave
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small cave. All around you, you see animal hides
made into the shapes of beds - very large beds. The walls are covered with
primitive art and soot.
   To the south, the cave opens up in to a passage leading east.

rooms.name: A Small Cave
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small cave. All around you, animal hides have
been made into the shapes of beds - very large beds.  The walls are 
covered with primitive art and soot.
   A passage leads out to the east.

rooms.name: A Passage Through the Caves
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a passage through a series of caves. The ceiling
here is covered with thousands of stalactites. The ground, however, is
smooth and worn from use.
   The passage here opens up into two small caves, one to the north, and
one to the west.  The passage continues to the east.

rooms.name: A Passage Through the Caves
